definitions.gloss: to send; to transmit (a message, data, signal)
definitions.explanation: To dispatch electronic communications such as emails, text messages, data files, or broadcast signals from one device or person to another.

examples.japanese: メールを{送信|そうしん}する。
{書類|しょるい}をファックスで{送信|そうしん}してください。
examples.english: Please send the documents by fax.

examples.japanese: {送信|そうしん}ボタンを{押|お}す{前|まえ}に、{内容|ないよう}をもう{一度|いちど}{確認|かくにん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should check the content one more time before pressing the send button.

notes:
Used specifically for electronic or signal-based communication. The basic meaning is dispatching information from a sender to a receiver through some medium (email, radio, network, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メールを{送信|そうしん}する: to send an email
- データを{送信|そうしん}する: to transmit data
- {信号|しんごう}を{送信|そうしん}する: to transmit a signal
- {送信|そうしん}ボタン: send button
- {送信|そうしん}{済|ず}み: already sent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送|おく}る: to send — general-purpose; includes physical items and people
- {発信|はっしん}する: to dispatch/originate — emphasizes the point of origin; also used for broadcasting ideas
- {転送|てんそう}する: to forward — sending something received onward to another recipient
